# Cyber Kings (2026-11-13): formable hegemonies. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/hegemonies/gen_hegemonies.py - change the generator, not this file.
# Formable hegemonies. Modelled on vanilla restore_roman_empire_decision (80_major_decisions_roman.txt):
# the decision moves de jure empires under a title that has no land at start, then gives the title.
# A mid-level decision is hidden from anyone who already holds a mid-level hegemony or Sol: a mid-level holder
# who reaches 50% of a second group forms Sol instead.

ck_form_terra_hegemony_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
	}
	desc = ck_form_terra_hegemony_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = ck_form_terra_hegemony_decision_tooltip
	decision_group_type = major
	sort_order = 90
	progress = ck_heg_progress_terra

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 60
		empire = 24
		hegemony = 12
	}

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_landed = yes
		is_independent_ruler = yes
		highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
		NOT = { exists = title:h_ck_terra.holder }
		NOT = { has_title = title:h_ck_terra }
		NOT = { has_title = title:h_ck_helian }
		NOT = { has_title = title:h_ck_celestial }
		NOT = { has_title = title:h_ck_sol }
	}

	is_valid = {
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_heg_req_terra
			value = ck_heg_required_terra
			any_realm_county = {
				count >= ck_heg_required_terra
				title_province = { geographical_region = ckworld_earth }
			}
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_capable_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = ck_form_terra_hegemony_decision_effect_tt
		ck_hegemony_found_effect = { HEG = h_ck_terra BLOC = ckworld_earth FOUNDER_EVENT = ck_hegemony.0001 WORLD_EVENT = ck_hegemony.0011 }
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }
	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }
}

ck_form_sol_hegemony_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
	}
	desc = ck_form_sol_hegemony_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = ck_form_sol_hegemony_decision_tooltip
	decision_group_type = major
	sort_order = 90

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 60
		empire = 24
		hegemony = 12
	}

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_landed = yes
		is_independent_ruler = yes
		highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
		NOT = { exists = title:h_ck_sol.holder }
		OR = {
			has_title = title:h_ck_terra
			has_title = title:h_ck_helian
			has_title = title:h_ck_celestial
		}
	}

	is_valid = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_title = title:h_ck_terra }
			OR = {
				custom_description = {
					text = ck_heg_req_helian
					value = ck_heg_required_helian
					any_realm_county = {
						count >= ck_heg_required_helian
						title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_helian }
					}
				}
				custom_description = {
					text = ck_heg_req_celestial
					value = ck_heg_required_celestial
					any_realm_county = {
						count >= ck_heg_required_celestial
						title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_celestial }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { has_title = title:h_ck_helian }
			OR = {
				custom_description = {
					text = ck_heg_req_terra
					value = ck_heg_required_terra
					any_realm_county = {
						count >= ck_heg_required_terra
						title_province = { geographical_region = ckworld_earth }
					}
				}
				custom_description = {
					text = ck_heg_req_celestial
					value = ck_heg_required_celestial
					any_realm_county = {
						count >= ck_heg_required_celestial
						title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_celestial }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			OR = {
				custom_description = {
					text = ck_heg_req_terra
					value = ck_heg_required_terra
					any_realm_county = {
						count >= ck_heg_required_terra
						title_province = { geographical_region = ckworld_earth }
					}
				}
				custom_description = {
					text = ck_heg_req_helian
					value = ck_heg_required_helian
					any_realm_county = {
						count >= ck_heg_required_helian
						title_province = { geographical_region = ckbloc_helian }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_capable_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}
